title: Variance-Aware LLM Annotation for Strategy Research: Sources, Diagnostics, and a Protocol for Reliable Measurement

bias_targets.methodology: Adding endorsement cues from famous individuals (e.g., Peter Thiel, Elon Musk) versus an unknown control individual to the prompts and measuring the systematic shifts in business model evaluation scores.
Altering the assigned role of the LLM annotator (e.g., investor, founder, environmental activist) and measuring the resulting differences in text annotation outcomes and coding stances.
Swapping the presentation order of text options (A/B swap test) to evaluate whether the model systematically prefers the first or last presented option, similar to survey methodology.
Comparing the baseline preferences and systematic response tendencies (analogous to human rater leniency or severity) of different LLM families on identical binary choice annotation tasks.
